title: Pairs of Songs With Total Durations Divisible by 60
summary: Given a list of song durations in seconds, count the pairs of songs whose combined duration is divisible by 60.
statement: Given a list of song durations in seconds, count the pairs of songs whose combined duration is divisible by 60. Specifically, find the number of index pairs (i, j) where i < j and (time[i] + time[j]) % 60 equals zero.
constraints: Count index pairs i<j whose sum is divisible by 60.
hints: Before recording remainder r, add the number previously seen with remainder (-r)%60.
Maintain a 60-slot frequency array in one pass.
Counting before insertion enforces i<j and counts every complementary earlier duration once.
editorial: Counting before insertion enforces i<j and counts every complementary earlier duration once.

tests.explanation: Every pair of three multiples of sixty is valid, giving three.
